meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会变成 GitHub 机器人,在 PR 或 Issue 评论里被 @ 时回复;第一次被 @ 后,这个讨论串的后续评论也会自动回复。
howto.when: 当某个已配置 Webhook 的仓库里,有人在 PR 或 Issue 评论中准确 @ 机器人账号时;首次 @ 后,该评论串的后续评论也会触发。

say.text: 帮我把 GitHub 频道接进来,用机器人账号回复 PR 评论。
say.note: 会复制适配器并引导配置凭据。

say.text: 配置 add-github,让 Issue 评论也能触发回复。
say.note: 会设置 webhook 并接线到智能体组。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a dedicated GitHub bot account: when @-mentioned in a PR or issue comment thread, it replies; after the first mention, the thread is subscribed and all follow-up comments are answered too.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment on a repo with the webhook set up; after the first mention, subsequent comments in that thread also trigger replies.

say_en.text: Help me add the GitHub channel and reply to PR comments with a bot account.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and guides you through credentials.

say_en.text: Set up add-github so issue comments can also trigger replies.
say_en.note: Sets up webhook and wires it to an agent group.

say_en.text: Use add-github with strict policy to limit who can trigger the agent.
